The force applied by each load due to gravity is calculated using , where is the mass of the load and is the acceleration due to gravity ( in this case).

For the upper wire, the total force applied is the weight of both masses (2 kg and 1 kg):

For the lower wire, the force applied is just the weight of the 1 kg mass:

Since the area and Young's modulus are the same for both wires, these values cancel out when we calculate the ratio of the strains. Therefore, the ratio of the strains is directly proportional to the ratio of the forces:
